For a [differentiable function](calculus-derivatives.qmd#def-differentiable) $f$ and a small step $\smallconst$,

$$f(w + \smallconst) \approx f(w) + \smallconst\,\dif{}{w}f(w)$$ {#eq-linear-approx}
